order: All five complete full suites, then all three complete task suites; no concurrent jobs. Full runs4-5 are preselected independent confirmations for every initial flag. All runs retained.
protocol: Existing frozen paired-rpc-v2 and task protocol, no repinning/fixture/engine/compatibility/config/logging changes. Record both arms RPC pings.
identity: Runtime expected build/HEAD/deployment recorded after helper deploy; every result must match.
costs: Preserve three full native CF audits of exact same library source as prior evidence; verify all new task native cost replays separately. Never infer dollar savings from time/statement counts.
decision: Preserve the four explicitly accepted workload signals. Review any additional >5% confirmed previous-code slowdown or accepted-case change whose CI lower bound exceeds its previously documented CI upper bound, using independent full confirmations4-5 (12 alternating pairs). Revert an unexplained unaccepted confirmed regression or correctness/cost failure. Never retry until favorable, omit workloads, subtract pings, or trim GC.
outputs: public-full-{1..5}.json and public-task-{1..3}.json; claims saved separately.
